title: Retention Scale by Share of Term Elapsed: Named Non-Owner Policy Cancellations at the Insured's Request
content:
**Scale.** For a Named Non-Owner Policy term cancelled at the named insured's request, the share of the term already run at the cancellation effective date — the days from the term's effective date to the cancellation effective date divided by the term's days — sets a multiplier of the package's insured-cancellation retention percentage, applied to that percentage before the reduction is taken.

| Share of the term run | Multiplier of the retention |
|---|---|
| under one quarter (below 0.25) | 1.5 |
| one quarter to under one half (0.25 up to but not including 0.5) | none |
| one half or more (0.5 and above) | 0.5 |

**Boundaries on a hypothetical 180-day term.**

| Days run at the cancellation effective date | Share | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 44 | 0.244 | 1.5 |
| 45 | 0.25 | none |
| 89 | 0.494 | none |
| 90 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
